title: More ways to use the text API
summary:
The model lineup grew, assistants gained image tools, and caching work took shape beneath a growing collection of community projects.

The `mistral` slot moved to vision-capable Mistral Small 3.1 2503, with streaming support, and `qwen-reasoning` added Qwen QWQ 32B. The lineup also dropped Claude 3.5 Haiku. The API began parsing `reasoning_effort`, though these changes do not establish that the value reaches the model provider.

A new MCP server gives assistants tools to create image URLs, fetch images as base64 data, and list image models. Its package and command were renamed to `pollinations-model-context-protocol`, with setup documentation updated to match. A community guide also showed how to connect Pollinations text models to OpenWebUI.

Two Cloudflare Workers added distinct caching paths: one for eligible image requests, keyed by URL path and normalized query parameters, and one that checks R2 before forwarding eligible text requests to the origin. Both retain bypasses for requests that should not be cached.

Jenny AI, Watch TV with neko, PixPax, Case Me, and OkeyAI API Playground joined the project listings. Existing Elixpo projects gained clearer author credits, while duplicate and outdated listing details were cleaned up.
